banner.readOnly: Read-only until paid: you can view and export

suspended.title: Your organization is suspended
suspended.body: Nobody can use it until support opens it again. Its data is kept as it was.
suspended.ownerCanRevoke: As its Owner, you can still take away someone's access: remove them, or give them a new password.

cancelled.title: Your organization's subscription has ended
cancelled.body: Its data is kept, locked, and nobody can use it. To start again, or for a copy of your data, contact support.

noSubscription.title: Your organization has no subscription yet
noSubscription.body: Nobody can use it until support sets one up.
